name: MuSiQue
description: Multihop Questions via Single-hop Question Composition (MuSiQue) is a multi-hop QA benchmark where 2-4 hop questions are constructed by combining single-hop questions. It addresses shortcut exploitation in multi-hop QA by ensuring answerable questions cannot be answered with fewer hops, and includes unanswerable variations to prevent reasoning shortcuts.
reputation: Rigorous multi-hop QA benchmark that prevents shortcut exploitation; published at TACL 2022; used to evaluate chain-of-thought and RAG systems
notes: Published at TACL 2022. Composed from 2, 3, and 4 hop questions. Answerable subset (24K) + unanswerable subset (5K). Questions tested to ensure they cannot be answered with fewer hops. Compared to HotpotQA, MuSiQue is more challenging due to explicit anti-shortcut construction. Used in IR and RAG system evaluation.
